piezas.titulo: Production writing: Everyday economics and employment
texto: Guided socio-economic synthesis writing (Superior level): write a formal expository text of several paragraphs analysing an employment or household-budget phenomenon. CU-TFL Superior requirements: 1) Presenting data with «รายงานเปรียบเทียบข้อมูล...» (a report comparing data...). 2) Contrasting comparison with «ในขณะที่...» (whereas...). 3) Causal derivation with «ส่งผลให้...» (which results in...). Keep to a rigorous academic register.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «ธุรกิจขนาดกลางและขนาดย่อมมีบทบาทสำคัญในการขับเคลื่อนเศรษฐกิจของชุมชน» express?

opciones.texto: Small and medium-sized enterprises drive the economic dynamism of the local community.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «ธุรกิจขนาดกลางและขนาดย่อมมีบทบาทสำคัญในการขับเคลื่อนเศรษฐกิจของชุมชน» from the text.

opciones.texto: Weighing returns and risks before investing helps keep financial capital stable.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another complementary statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Planning monthly income and spending budgets strengthens household financial security.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.
